## Focused retry complete — no GO source exists in this environment; final answer delivered as a labelled best-effort inference (per your route 3).

**Final answer (INFERENCE, not enrichment output):** **cellular response to DNA damage stimulus** (GO:0006974; GO_Biological_Process_2021 label ~"Cellular Response To DNA Damage Stimulus"), enriched **UP** in CBD+cisplatin combination vs DMSO → NES direction **positive**. NES/nominal-p/FDR cannot be honestly quoted because gseapy never ran.

**(1) Exhaustive offline search — all negative:** no GMT/Enrichr/msigdb/GAF/OBO/gene2go/obograph anywhere (/opt, /usr/share, /root, /var, /tmp, /home, /workspace, /usr/local, apt caches, pip/uv caches); only site-packages in two Python envs are numpy/pandas/scipy/statsmodels/openpyxl (+deps) — no gseapy/decoupler/omnipath/pyensembl/scanpy, no conda pkgs, no R libs. Only "ontology" hit was a Nautilus demo file.

**Network routes — all dead:** no proxy env vars, no pip.conf, /etc/resolv.conf empty; /proc/net/route has zero routes (loopback only); raw TCP to hardcoded IPs (maayanlab 443, pypi 443, cloudflare 443, 8.8.8.8:53) all fail OSError — this is a link-level block, not just DNS.

**(2) gseapy-faithful prerank:** not runnable — a prerank needs a gene-set library and none exists; per your instruction I did not pass off unrelated sets as GO_Biological_Process_2021. Instead I ran hand-curated marker-set diagnostics (explicitly NOT GO files) on the approved ranked list.

**(3) Winner + robustness:** The ranked list's extreme top is dominated by p53/DNA-damage-response: 9/50 top genes are canonical p53 targets (GDA rank 1, BTG2, AEN, CDKN1A, FDXR, PPM1D, TP53INP1, FAS, GDF15, ZMAT3), median capped-p percentile 0.975. Opposing tail: HIF/glycolysis (0.007 percentile) + AP-1/IEG down; cholesterol/SREBP mildly down; HR/repair genes flat (the driver is the p53 response, not repair per se). Stability across ranking variants: p53/DDD stays top ~2.5% (capped -log10p at 16) and top ~10% (log2FC-only); hypoxia stays bottom ~1–3% in both; for expressed genes (baseMean≥5) the **top-300 is 300/300 identical** between original and capped rankings — the winning tail is stable despite Wald p overconfidence. Between the two extreme programs I chose the UP DNA-damage term as most defensible single answer (mechanistically cisplatin is the DNA-damaging agent; signal occupies the absolute list extreme); hypoxia-down is the runner-up and would be the alternative if the true prerank favored negative NES.

**Deliverables (all executed, on disk):** `analysis_cbd_cisplatin_de.py` (main DE pipeline), `robustness_check.py`, `out/de_combination_vs_dmso.csv`, `out/ranked_gene_list.csv`, `out/robustness_check_output.txt`, `out/ANSWER.md` (final term + caveats), `out/ENRICHMENT_BLOCKER.md`.

**Limitations:** (1) term is inference from DE extremes, NOT a gseapy/GO_Biological_Process_2021 result — FDR/NES unavailable; (2) exact Enrichr label casing unverified (no library access); (3) overconfident Wald p-values could not be fully audited, only bounded via capped-ranking robustness; (4) n=3/group.
